channels.fill: One scalar country surface at a time.
channels.pattern: Categorical/set membership on the flat country surface.
channels.outline: Selection, query match, hover and focus emphasis.
channels.line: Typed relationships, declared routes, flows and geographic boundaries.
channels.point: Honestly located entities, places and physical assets.

fill+pattern.reason: Scalar color and categorical membership use distinct flat-surface channels.

fill+outline.reason: Selection and query emphasis remain boundary channels.

pattern+outline.reason: Membership and selection/query emphasis remain independently legible.

fill+height.reason: Color and height may encode separate named scalar questions.

pattern+height.reason: The current membership pattern is a flat fill layer and is not mapped onto extrusion side/top surfaces.

guardrails: Only one scalar owns country color at a time.
Only one scalar owns country height at a time.
A schematic relationship line must declare geometry meaning and must not imply a surveyed physical route.
Unsupported channel combinations degrade to the more information-preserving representation rather than silently misrendering.
Progressive UI is a compatibility presentation surface and must not write canonical country paint channels.
